senses.en: used to introduce a second point or reason

ex.en: Firstly, the plan is too expensive; secondly, it will take too long.
ex.zh: 第一，這個計畫太貴；第二，它太花時間。

senses.en: the action or state of keeping something secret

ex.en: The negotiations were conducted in complete secrecy.
ex.zh: 談判在完全保密的情況下進行。

senses.en: a person who handles office work, letters, and appointments
the head of a government department

ex.en: The secretary scheduled the meeting for Monday morning.
ex.zh: 祕書把會議排在星期一早上。

root.note: 負責機密事務的人 → 祕書

mn: 美國的 Secretary of State 是國務卿，相當於外交部長。

senses.en: inclined to hide feelings or information
senses.zh: 遮遮掩掩的；守口如瓶的

ex.en: He became secretive and stopped telling his parents where he went.
ex.zh: 他變得神神祕祕，不再告訴父母他去哪裡。

senses.en: calm, quiet, and unhurried
to calm someone with a drug

ex.en: The vet had to sedate the frightened dog before examining it.
ex.zh: 獸醫在檢查那隻受驚的狗之前，得先給牠打鎮靜劑。

root.note: 使坐定、安靜下來 → 沉著的；使鎮靜

senses.en: involving a lot of sitting and little physical activity
(of animals or people) staying in one place

ex.en: A sedentary lifestyle increases the risk of heart disease.
ex.zh: 久坐不動的生活方式會增加心臟病的風險。

root.note: 一直坐著的 → 久坐的

senses.en: matter that settles to the bottom of a liquid

ex.en: Over thousands of years, sediment built up at the bottom of the lake.
ex.zh: 經過數千年，湖底堆積了沉積物。

root.note: 沉坐在底部的東西 → 沉積物

senses.en: speech or action that encourages rebellion against the government

ex.en: The journalist was arrested and charged with sedition.
ex.zh: 那名記者被捕，並被控煽動叛亂。

root.note: 分開走、另立門戶 → 叛亂

senses.en: inciting rebellion against authority

ex.en: The government banned the seditious pamphlets.
ex.zh: 政府查禁了那些煽動叛亂的小冊子。

root.note: 煽動分離的 → 煽動叛亂的

senses.en: to attract someone into sexual activity
to persuade someone to do something unwise by making it attractive

ex.en: Low prices can seduce shoppers into buying things they don't need.
ex.zh: 低價會誘使消費者買下不需要的東西。

root.note: 把人引到一旁 → 誘惑

senses.en: showing dedication and careful effort; diligent

ex.en: The sedulous student reviewed her notes every single night.
ex.zh: 那位勤勉的學生每天晚上都複習筆記。

parts.m: zealous 熱心的（拉丁文 sedulus）

root.note: 熱心投入的 → 勤勉的

senses.en: a person who can supposedly see the future

ex.en: The king asked the old seer what the future held.
ex.zh: 國王問那位老預言家未來會如何。

root.note: 看得見（未來）的人 → 預言家

senses.en: to be filled with intense but hidden anger
(of a liquid) to boil or churn
(of a place) to be crowded with moving people

ex.en: She would silently seethe whenever her brother took credit for her work.
ex.zh: 每當哥哥搶她的功勞，她都會默默怒火中燒。

senses.en: a feudal lord; a man of rank

ex.en: Every peasant owed labor to the local seignior.
ex.zh: 每個農奴都必須為當地領主服勞役。

parts.m: older 年長的（拉丁文 senior）

root.note: 年長者 → 領主（senior 同源）

senses.en: an instrument that measures and records earthquakes

ex.en: The seismograph recorded a strong earthquake early this morning.
ex.zh: 地震儀記錄到今天清晨的一場強烈地震。

senses.en: to take hold of suddenly and forcefully
to take an opportunity eagerly
(of police) to confiscate

ex.en: You should seize every chance to practice speaking English.
ex.zh: 你應該把握每個練習說英文的機會。

mn: 拼法例外：seize 是 ei，不是 ie。

senses.en: careful in choosing; choosing only the best
affecting only certain things

ex.en: The university is very selective and accepts only ten percent of applicants.
ex.zh: 這所大學非常挑，只錄取百分之十的申請者。

root.note: 分開挑選的 → 挑剔的

senses.en: pride and confidence in oneself

ex.en: Losing his job hurt his self-respect more than his bank account.
ex.zh: 失業對他自尊的打擊比對存款的打擊還大。

root.note: 回頭好好看待自己 → 自尊

senses.en: the outward appearance of something, often when the reality is different

ex.en: After the storm, the town slowly returned to some semblance of normal life.
ex.zh: 暴風雨後，小鎮慢慢恢復了一點正常生活的樣子。

senses.en: occurring twice a year
senses.zh: 半年一次的；一年兩次的

ex.en: The store is holding its semiannual sale this weekend.
ex.zh: 這家店這個週末舉辦半年一次的特賣。

senses.en: half of a circle

ex.en: The children sat in a semicircle around the teacher.
ex.zh: 孩子們圍著老師坐成半圓形。

senses.en: partly civilized

ex.en: Older travel books often described foreign tribes as semicivilized.
ex.zh: 舊時的遊記常把外國部落描述成半開化的。

mn: 這是帶有殖民偏見的舊式用詞，現代文章中應避免使用。

senses.en: partly conscious; not fully awake or aware

ex.en: The injured hiker was semiconscious when rescuers found him.
ex.zh: 救援人員找到那位受傷的登山客時，他已經半昏迷。

senses.en: a class or meeting for discussion and training

ex.en: I signed up for a seminar on public speaking.
ex.zh: 我報名了一場關於公開演講的研討會。

root.note: 播撒知識種子的地方 → 研討會

senses.en: a school that trains priests, ministers, or rabbis

ex.en: He studied at a seminary for four years before becoming a priest.
ex.zh: 他在神學院念了四年才成為神父。

root.note: 培育種子的苗圃 → 培育神職人員的學校

senses.en: having weakened mental ability because of old age

ex.en: Her grandfather is ninety but not at all senile.
ex.zh: 她爺爺九十歲了，但一點也不糊塗。

root.note: 年老的 → 衰老的（senior 同源）

senses.en: a physical feeling
a state of great public excitement, or its cause
senses.zh: 轟動；轟動一時的人或事

ex.en: The young singer became an overnight sensation.
ex.zh: 那位年輕歌手一夜爆紅。

root.note: 感覺；引起強烈感受 → 轟動

senses.en: one of the faculties such as sight or hearing
good judgment
to become aware of without being told

ex.en: Dogs have a very strong sense of smell.
ex.zh: 狗的嗅覺非常靈敏。

mn: make sense 是「合理」；common sense 是「常識」。

senses.en: the ability to appreciate and respond to complex emotions or art
(sensibilities) a person's feelings that can easily be offended

ex.en: The poet's sensibility shows in every line she writes.
ex.zh: 這位詩人細膩的感受力展現在她寫的每一行詩裡。

mn: 不是 sense（理智）的名詞；珍．奧斯汀的《理性與感性》就是 Sense and Sensibility。

senses.en: quick to detect or respond to slight changes
easily upset or offended
senses.zh: 易受傷害的；神經過敏的

senses.en: requiring careful handling; secret

ex.en: Politics can be a sensitive topic at family dinners.
ex.zh: 在家庭聚餐時，政治可能是個敏感話題。

root.note: 容易感覺到的 → 敏感的

senses.en: the sensory apparatus or faculties considered as a whole

ex.en: Virtual reality aims to engage the entire human sensorium.
ex.zh: 虛擬實境的目標是調動人全部的感官。

root.note: 產生感覺的地方 → 感覺中樞

senses.en: relating to physical, especially sexual, pleasure
senses.zh: 肉慾的；感官享樂的；性感的

ex.en: The perfume ad showed a slow, sensual dance.
ex.zh: 那支香水廣告拍了一段緩慢而性感的舞蹈。

root.note: 身體感覺上的 → 肉慾的

mn: sensual 偏向肉體慾望；sensuous 偏向美感享受。

senses.en: relating to or pleasing the senses, especially aesthetically

ex.en: The painter was known for his sensuous use of color.
ex.zh: 那位畫家以色彩運用帶給人豐富的感官享受而聞名。

mn: sensuous 是感官上的美感（音樂、色彩）；sensual 是肉慾的。

senses.en: a group of words that expresses a complete thought
the punishment given by a court
to state the punishment for a convicted person

ex.en: The judge gave him a sentence of five years in prison.
ex.zh: 法官判他五年徒刑。

root.note: 表達意見 → 句子；法官的意見 → 判決

senses.en: the ability to perceive or feel things

ex.en: Scientists debate whether fish have sentience and can feel pain.
ex.zh: 科學家爭論魚是否有感知能力、會不會感到疼痛。

senses.en: able to perceive or feel things
senses.zh: 有知覺的；有感知能力的

ex.en: The movie is about a robot that becomes sentient.
ex.zh: 這部電影講一個產生自我意識的機器人。

root.note: 能感覺的 → 有知覺的

senses.en: a soldier or guard who keeps watch

ex.en: An old oak tree stood like a sentinel at the edge of the field.
ex.zh: 一棵老橡樹像哨兵一樣佇立在田野邊緣。

root.note: 負責察覺動靜的人 → 哨兵

senses.en: able to be separated or treated separately

ex.en: In this case, the two issues are not easily separable.
ex.zh: 在這個案例中，這兩個問題不容易分開處理。

senses.en: [ˋsɛpəˏret] to cause to move or be apart
[ˋsɛpərɪt] forming a unit by itself; not joined

ex.en: Please separate the recyclables from the regular trash.
ex.zh: 請把可回收物和一般垃圾分開。

mn: 拼法常錯：中間是 -par-（there is "a rat" in sep-a-rate）。

senses.en: a person who supports separation of a group from a larger body, especially a country
supporting such separation

ex.en: The separatist movement demanded independence for the region.
ex.zh: 這個分離主義運動要求該地區獨立。

senses.en: lasting for or occurring every seven years
senses.zh: 每七年一次的；持續七年的

ex.en: The town celebrates a septennial festival that draws huge crowds.
ex.zh: 這個小鎮每七年舉辦一次節慶，吸引大批人潮。

senses.en: a small room or monument cut in rock where a dead person is buried

ex.en: The king was laid to rest in a marble sepulcher.
ex.zh: 國王被安葬在一座大理石墓室中。

senses.en: inclined to follow others without thinking; lacking independence

ex.en: The sequacious crowd cheered whatever the leader said.
ex.zh: 盲從的群眾對領袖說的任何話都報以歡呼。

root.note: 很愛跟隨的 → 盲從的

senses.en: a book, film, or game that continues an earlier story
something that follows as a result

ex.en: Fans are waiting eagerly for the sequel to the hit movie.
ex.zh: 影迷熱切期待這部賣座電影的續集。

senses.en: a particular order in which things follow each other
a set of related events or things

ex.en: Put the pictures in the correct sequence to tell the story.
ex.zh: 把圖片按照正確的順序排好來說故事。

root.note: 一個跟著一個 → 順序

senses.en: following in order or as a result

ex.en: Each sequent chapter builds on the ideas of the one before.
ex.zh: 每一個接續的章節都建立在前一章的概念上。

senses.en: to isolate or hide away
to take legal possession of property until a debt is paid
(science) to absorb and store, such as carbon

ex.en: The judge decided to sequester the jury during the trial.
ex.zh: 法官決定在審判期間隔離陪審團。

root.note: 交給第三方保管 → 隔離、扣押

senses.en: to take legal possession of assets until a debt is paid

ex.en: The court can sequestrate the company's assets to pay its creditors.
ex.zh: 法院可以扣押公司資產來償還債權人。

root.note: 交給第三方保管 → 扣押

senses.en: a noncommissioned officer in the army or a police officer below lieutenant

ex.en: The sergeant ordered the soldiers to line up.
ex.zh: 中士命令士兵排好隊。

mn: 拼法和發音不同：ser 唸成 [sɑr]。

senses.en: an officer who keeps order in a legislature or court

ex.en: The sergeant-at-arms escorted the noisy protester out of the chamber.
ex.zh: 警衛官把吵鬧的抗議者帶出議事廳。

senses.en: a high-ranking noncommissioned officer

ex.en: The sergeant-major inspected the troops before the parade.
ex.zh: 士官長在閱兵前檢閱部隊。

senses.en: the action of helping or doing work for someone
a system supplying a public need
a religious ceremony

ex.en: The restaurant is famous for its friendly service.
ex.zh: 這家餐廳以親切的服務出名。

senses.en: fulfilling its function adequately; usable
functional rather than attractive

ex.en: The old car is not pretty, but it is still serviceable.
ex.zh: 這台舊車不好看，但還能用。

root.note: 還能提供服務的 → 堪用的

senses.en: the state of being a slave or completely controlled by someone

ex.en: Many immigrants were trapped in servitude to pay off their debts.
ex.zh: 許多移民為了還債而陷入被奴役的處境。

senses.en: the ending of a connection or relationship
money paid to an employee whose job is ended

ex.en: The laid-off workers each received a month of severance pay.
ex.zh: 被裁的員工每人拿到一個月的資遣費。

root.note: 切斷關係 → 斷絕；解雇補償

senses.en: to a very great or serious degree
in a strict or harsh way

ex.en: Several houses were severely damaged by the flood.
ex.zh: 好幾間房子被洪水嚴重損壞。

senses.en: a group of six people playing music or singing together, or music for them

ex.en: A jazz sextet played at the wedding reception.
ex.zh: 一個爵士六重奏樂團在婚宴上表演。

senses.en: consisting of six parts; six times as much
to multiply by six

ex.en: Sales managed to sextuple in just two years.
ex.zh: 銷售額在短短兩年內成長了六倍。

senses.en: nothing but; complete (used for emphasis)
(of a cliff or wall) extremely steep
(of fabric) very thin

ex.en: She won the race through sheer determination.
ex.zh: 她完全靠決心贏得這場比賽。

senses.en: lazy and lacking ambition

ex.en: His parents worried that he had become shiftless after dropping out of school.
ex.zh: 父母擔心他輟學後變得懶散不求上進。

root.note: 不想辦法、不努力 → 懶惰的

senses.en: having sharp judgment, especially in practical matters

ex.en: She made a shrewd decision to buy the house before prices rose.
ex.zh: 她很精明，在房價上漲前就買了房子。

senses.en: to make a high, loud cry
a high, loud cry

ex.en: The children began to shriek with delight when they saw the clown.
ex.zh: 孩子們看到小丑，開心得尖叫起來。

senses.en: the process or amount of becoming smaller
loss of stock in a store due to theft or damage

ex.en: Wash the sweater in cold water to prevent shrinkage.
ex.zh: 用冷水洗毛衣，以免縮水。

senses.en: to wrinkle and shrink, especially from heat or dryness

ex.en: Without water, the leaves will shrivel and turn brown.
ex.zh: 沒有水的話，葉子會枯萎變成褐色。

senses.en: to walk by dragging one's feet
to mix playing cards into a random order
to rearrange or move things around

ex.en: Please shuffle the cards before you deal them.
ex.zh: 發牌前請先洗牌。

senses.en: a hissing sound, especially of s or sh

ex.en: The poem's sibilance imitates the sound of the sea.
ex.zh: 這首詩大量的嘶嘶音模仿海浪的聲音。

parts.m: hiss 嘶嘶作響（拉丁文 sibilare）

senses.en: making a hissing sound
a speech sound like s, z, or sh

ex.en: The snake made a low, sibilant sound.
ex.zh: 那條蛇發出低沉的嘶嘶聲。

senses.en: to make a hissing sound; to pronounce with a hiss

ex.en: The steam began to sibilate as it escaped from the pipe.
ex.zh: 蒸氣從管子冒出時開始嘶嘶作響。

senses.en: directed to or from one side; sideways
toward the side; obliquely

ex.en: She gave him a sidelong glance to see if he was listening.
ex.zh: 她斜眼瞄了他一下，看他有沒有在聽。

senses.en: relating to the stars or measured by them

ex.en: A sidereal day is about four minutes shorter than a solar day.
ex.zh: 一個恆星日比一個太陽日短大約四分鐘。

senses.en: a military operation surrounding a place to force it to surrender
a period of persistent attack or pressure

ex.en: The city survived a siege that lasted almost a year.
ex.zh: 這座城市撐過了將近一年的圍城。

parts.m: seat 座位（拉丁文 sedere 坐）

root.note: 軍隊坐在城外不走 → 包圍

mn: under siege 是「被包圍、受到強烈攻擊」。

senses.en: the quality of being important
the meaning of something

ex.en: Historians still debate the significance of the treaty.
ex.zh: 歷史學家至今仍在爭論這份條約的重要性。

root.note: 做出記號、表示意義 → 意義、重要性

senses.en: large or important enough to be noticed
having a particular meaning

ex.en: There has been a significant increase in the number of students.
ex.zh: 學生人數大幅增加。

root.note: 值得做記號的 → 重要的

mn: significant other 是「另一半、伴侶」。

senses.en: the meaning of a word or sign

ex.en: Linguists study the signification of words across cultures.
ex.zh: 語言學家研究詞語在不同文化中的含義。

root.note: 用記號表達的東西 → 含義

senses.en: alike but not identical

ex.en: The two brothers have similar tastes in music.
ex.zh: 這兩兄弟的音樂品味很相似。

senses.en: a figure of speech comparing two things using "like" or "as"

ex.en: "As brave as a lion" is a simile.
ex.zh: 「像獅子一樣勇敢」是一個明喻。

mn: simile 用 like/as；metaphor（隱喻）直接說 A 是 B。

senses.en: the quality of being similar; resemblance
a comparison or parable

ex.en: The novel has a strong similitude to real events of the war.
ex.zh: 這本小說與那場戰爭的真實事件非常相似。

senses.en: to make something easier to understand or do

ex.en: The new app helps simplify the process of paying bills.
ex.zh: 這個新 App 幫忙簡化繳帳單的流程。

senses.en: to imitate the appearance or conditions of something
to pretend to have or feel

ex.en: Pilots train on machines that simulate real flight conditions.
ex.zh: 飛行員在模擬真實飛行狀況的機器上受訓。

root.note: 使看起來相似 → 模擬

senses.en: happening at the same time

ex.en: The speech was broadcast with simultaneous translation into five languages.
ex.zh: 這場演講同步翻譯成五種語言播出。

parts.m: at the same time 同時（拉丁文 simul）

senses.en: a job that pays well but requires little work

ex.en: His title sounded impressive, but the job was really a sinecure.
ex.zh: 他的頭銜聽起來很厲害，但那份工作其實是個閒差。

root.note: 不必操心照顧（教區）的職位 → 閒差

senses.en: to burn slightly on the surface

ex.en: Be careful not to singe your eyebrows when you light the grill.
ex.zh: 點烤爐時小心別燒到眉毛。

mn: 別和 sing（唱歌）搞混：singe 多了個 e，唸 [sɪndʒ]。

senses.en: giving the impression that something harmful or evil is happening

ex.en: There was something sinister about the empty house at the end of the street.
ex.zh: 街尾那間空屋有種說不出的陰森感。

root.note: 古代認為左邊不吉利 → 不祥的

senses.en: the quality of having many curves; a bend

ex.en: The sinuosity of the mountain road made the drive slow.
ex.zh: 山路蜿蜒曲折，讓車速變得很慢。

parts.m: curve, bend 彎曲（拉丁文 sinus）

senses.en: having many curves and turns
moving in a graceful, flowing way

ex.en: A sinuous river winds through the green valley.
ex.zh: 一條蜿蜒的河流穿過翠綠的山谷。

senses.en: a hollow space in the bones of the face connected to the nose

ex.en: A sinus infection can cause headaches and a stuffy nose.
ex.zh: 鼻竇炎會造成頭痛和鼻塞。

parts.m: curve, hollow 彎曲、凹處（拉丁文）

root.note: 骨頭裡的凹洞 → 鼻竇

senses.en: a device that makes a loud warning sound
(Greek myth) a creature whose singing lured sailors to their death; a dangerously attractive woman
senses.zh: （希臘神話）海妖賽蓮；妖豔危險的女子

ex.en: We heard the siren of an ambulance in the distance.
ex.zh: 我們聽到遠處救護車的警笛聲。

mn: siren song 比喻「誘人但危險的吸引力」。

senses.en: a hot, dusty wind blowing from North Africa across the Mediterranean
senses.zh: 西洛可風（北非吹向南歐的熱風）

ex.en: The sirocco brought red dust all the way to Sicily.
ex.zh: 西洛可風把紅色沙塵一路吹到西西里島。

senses.en: the relationship between sisters; a feeling of friendship among women
a group of women with a shared interest, especially a religious order

ex.en: The team members shared a strong sense of sisterhood.
ex.zh: 隊員之間有著深厚的姊妹情誼。

senses.en: a person who tends to doubt accepted opinions
senses.zh: 懷疑論者；抱持懷疑態度的人

ex.en: Even the biggest skeptic was convinced after seeing the evidence.
ex.zh: 連最多疑的人看到證據後也被說服了。

parts.m: examine, consider 審視（希臘文 skeptesthai）

root.note: 凡事都要仔細審視的人 → 懷疑者

senses.en: a doubting attitude toward claims or beliefs

ex.en: The public greeted the company's promises with skepticism.
ex.zh: 民眾對這家公司的承諾抱持懷疑。

root.note: 凡事審視的態度 → 懷疑

senses.en: a small, light boat for rowing or sailing

ex.en: The fisherman rowed his skiff across the calm lake.
ex.zh: 漁夫划著小艇越過平靜的湖面。

senses.en: a brief fight between small groups of soldiers
a short argument
to engage in a skirmish

ex.en: A skirmish broke out between the two groups of fans after the game.
ex.zh: 比賽結束後，兩派球迷爆發小衝突。

senses.en: skill in using the hands, especially to deceive

ex.en: The magician's sleight of hand amazed the audience.
ex.zh: 魔術師的巧妙手法讓觀眾看得目瞪口呆。

mn: 幾乎只用在 sleight of hand（手法、障眼法）；發音同 slight。

senses.en: small in degree; minor
(of a person) small and thin
to insult by treating with disrespect

ex.en: There has been a slight improvement in his condition.
ex.zh: 他的病情稍微好轉了。

senses.en: lazy and inactive

ex.en: After a slothful weekend on the couch, he felt guilty.
ex.zh: 在沙發上懶散度過一個週末之後，他感到很內疚。

mn: sloth 也是動作超慢的「樹懶」。

senses.en: a lazy, sluggish person

ex.en: The old proverb tells the sluggard to learn from the busy ant.
ex.zh: 古老的箴言叫懶惰的人向勤勞的螞蟻學習。

senses.en: willing to talk and do things with other people

ex.en: Our new neighbor is very sociable and invited everyone to dinner.
ex.zh: 我們的新鄰居很好客，請大家吃晚飯。

root.note: 可以當同伴的 → 愛交際的

senses.en: a political and economic theory in which society or the state owns or controls major industries

ex.en: The class compared capitalism and socialism.
ex.zh: 課堂上比較了資本主義和社會主義。

senses.en: a person who supports socialism
relating to socialism

ex.en: The socialist party promised free healthcare for all.
ex.zh: 社會黨承諾全民免費醫療。
